name: SectionHead - Centered
description: The centred variant, which is not a cosmetic switch: the head is a space-between flex row built for a title at one end and an action at the other, so centring means dropping the row behaviour and stacking. Six bands ship in this state today — both chapter event sections, the subscribe band, the WhatsApp join band, the forming-chapter band, the community callouts and the Luma calendar — so the left-aligned frame alone would leave the more common arrangement unpictured.
